sentences.text: Lewis Friedman is an American screenwriter and speechwriter .
A two-time Emmy nominee , he has written for television and film since 1998 .

His credits include the films The Comedian , BASEketball and An American Carol , the Music in High Places documentary series , and television specials such as the Kennedy Center Honors .	An American Carol	An American Carol	BASEketball	BASEketball	The Comedian	The Comedian (2016 film)	Kennedy Center Honors	Kennedy Center Honors
Friedman was born in New York City and grew up in Milwaukee , Wisconsin , where he attended Shorewood High School .	Shorewood High School	Shorewood High School (Wisconsin)
He began his career in Milwaukee in 1972 as a promoter , and later moved to New York , where he promoted Broadway shows such as Stories by Chapin , Comedy with Music and The Middle of Nowhere .

His television scripts have focused on the performing arts , and include awards shows such as the Kennedy Center Honors , the Golden Globes , and the Directors Guild Awards .	Kennedy Center Honors	Kennedy Center Honors	Golden Globes	Golden Globes	Directors Guild Awards	Directors Guild Awards

In addition to the 22 episodes of Music in High Places , which featured artists such as India.Arie , Ryan Adams , and Alanis Morissette , he has written documentaries about Bob Marley and Burt Bacharach . He was nominated for two Emmy Award for Outstanding Writing for his work on the 2010 and 2012 The Kennedy Center Honors : A Celebration of the Performing Arts specials .	Kennedy Center Honors	Kennedy Center Honors
He was nominated for a Writers Guild Award in 2012 and 2016 .
